children.name: Trigonochlamys imitatrix O.Boettger, 1881
children.description: Trigonochlamys imitatrix is a species of predatory air-breathing land slug.

children.name: Drilolestes retowskii
children.description:
Drilolestes retowskii is a species of predatory air-breathing land slug. It is a shell-less pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Trigonochlamydidae.
Drilolestes retowskii is the only species in the genus Drilolestes.

children.name: Hyrcanolestes velitaris
children.description:
Hyrcanolestes is a monotypic genus containing the single species Hyrcanolestes velitaris, a predatory air-breathing land slug. It is a shell-less pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Trigonochlamydidae.
The generic name Hyrcanolestes contains the suffix -lestes, that means "robber".

children.name: Boreolestes likharevi Schileyko & Kijashko, 1999
children.description:
External: See description for genus; only right side of horseshoe-shaped groove in mantle well-developed (Schileyko & Kijashko 1999).

Internal: Irregularly-shaped albumin gland; vas deferens sticking to penis; long, tapering penis; two wide, papillate pilasters inside penis; no glandular pads or spermatophores in penis; retractor muscle attached to penis apex; short oviduct, equal to vagina length; ovate spermatheca with short, thin duct; perivaginal gland around vagina and base of spermatheca (Schileyko & Kijashko 1999).

children.name: Boreolestes sylvestris Kijashko, 1999
children.description:
External: See description for genus; horseshoe groove in mantle with fully present (Schileyko & Kijashko 1999).

Internal: Somewhat triangular-shaped albumin gland; vas deferens not stuck to side of penis; fairly long penis; two pilasters inside penis, with entire internal walls of penis papillate; no glandular pads or spermatophores in penis; retractor muscle attached at apex of penis under vas deferens; oviduct slightly longer than vagina; spermatheca small and somewhat long; perivaginal gland around upper vagina and base of spermatheca (Schileyko & Kijashko 1999).

children.name: Lesticulus nocturnus Schileyko, 1988
children.description:
External: Small and white cave-dwellers; spindle-shaped body; vertical grooves in skin; mantle on mid-dorsum; mantle with cephalic shield 1/3 its length and no horseshoe-shaped groove; free edge on right mantle edge; eyes almost absent; strong, "corrugated" keel; narrow sole (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: Short vas deferens and penial retractor muscle join apex of penis; long, thin penis with a widened apical end; penis apex containing longitudinal folds with transverse wrinkles along their length; sheath around lower penis; oviduct very long; short vagina; very thin, long atrium attached to retentor muscles (Schileyko 2003).

children.name: Troglolestes sokolovi Liovushkin & Matiokin, 1965
children.description:
Exterior: White body (cave dweller); body cylindrical while moving; mantle covers dorsum except for head, neck, and tail tip, and covered with tubercles; cephalic shield covers 1/4 length of mantle; weak horseshoe groove in mantle; pneumostome on posterior end of mantle; eyes reduced (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: Throat 1/3 body length, with two rows of protractor muscles; barbed teeth; no jaw; short vas deferens; penis club-shaped with wide apex; spermatheca with a short, thin stalk and a muscular accessory structure containing a papilla at its base; oviduct and vagina fairly long; fairly long atrium (Schileyko 2003).
